entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena, Laurento, Lucita and I gathe..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena, Laurento, Lucita and I gathered once more in my council chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I realized that everyone was waitin..."
entries.dialogueText: I realized that everyone was waiting for me to speak.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Elena's eyes rest on my Wruhe..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Elena's eyes rest on my Wruhecist prayer medallion. I wore it on my chest almost constantly now.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My dearest advisors.""
entries.dialogueText: "My dearest advisors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My friends.""
entries.dialogueText: "My friends."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You already know what's going on...."
entries.dialogueText: "You already know what's going on. So I will keep this short."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for staying by my side a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for staying by my side all these years. I know it was not always easy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The wisdom and integrity with whic..."
entries.dialogueText: "The wisdom and integrity with which you have served the Rizian throne will never be forgotten."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our kingdom is undergoing a transf..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our kingdom is undergoing a transformation. And unfortunately, it could not do so without casualties."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish that I could keep you on my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish that I could keep you on my new council. Alas, it is not God's will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is nothing personal. But my Hol..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is nothing personal. But my Holy Kingdom must be led by those with the utmost purity of faith."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As has been prophesied, only a cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "As has been prophesied, only a council of true Wruhecist believers can bring forth Golconda in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish that I could have kept you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish that I could have kept you on. But alas, the very concept of a Royal Council went against my reform goals."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Should you wish to run for elected..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should you wish to run for elected office under Rizia's new government structure, I will support you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Most of you are getting on in year..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most of you are getting on in years, anyway. The governance of this country shouldn't be trusted to a group of senior citizens."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My councilors frowned at each other..."
entries.dialogueText: My councilors frowned at each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My councilors frowned at each other..."
entries.dialogueText: My councilors frowned at each other. Finally, Elena spoke up.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Thank you anyway for the opportuni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you anyway for the opportunity, Your Majesty. It has been a pleasure serving three generations of the Toras family."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I am glad to have helped you build..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am glad to have helped you build the foundations for a profitable kingdom going forward. Even if I won't be part of it."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And I am looking forward to seeing..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am looking forward to seeing our nation become a great energy powerhouse."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I hope the new government will hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope the new government will have more success than I did in building the foundations for a profitable future."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And I hope that one day Rizia may..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I hope that one day Rizia may become the great energy powerhouse I envisioned."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""For my part, I am glad to have pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "For my part, I am glad to have played a role in the formation of the Interkopum Alliance. If we are lucky, the connections we have built will outlive us all."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course, I deeply regret that I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, I deeply regret that I did not do more to prevent the Pales War. So many lives lost..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""For my part, I am glad to have pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "For my part, I am glad to have played a small role in the reunification of Pales and Rizia. If it all goes according to plan, the course of history will be changed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course, I deeply regret that I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, I deeply regret that I did not do more to prevent the loss of Zille."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course, I deeply regret that I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, I deeply regret that I did not do more to prevent the deterioration of relations between Rizia and Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""May the change in government bring..."
entries.dialogueText: "May the change in government bring our kingdom new possibilities for international partnerships."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's arms were folded. He didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's arms were folded. He didn't speak.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I share Elena's sentiments, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "I share Elena's sentiments, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you have something to say, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you have something to say, Your Grace?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Uncle Hugo, I hope you will forgiv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uncle Hugo, I hope you will forgive me. We are still family, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry, Hugo. But you must und..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry, Hugo. But you must understand why I did what I did."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand. But I wish I had a l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. But I wish I had a larger part to play in this new theocracy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My hand was forced by circumstance..."
entries.dialogueText: "My hand was forced by circumstances beyond my control. If I did not dissolve the Royal Council, Rizia would have fallen prey to revolutionaries."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am a man of God as well, after a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am a man of God as well, after all."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I hope you remember that I was the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you remember that I was the one who set you on the path of Wruhecist enlightenment in the first place."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Only that I wish I had a larger pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only that I wish I had a larger part to play in this new theocracy."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We are. But I do wish I had a larg..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are. But I do wish I had a larger part to play in this new theocracy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do not doubt your devotion, Hugo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not doubt your devotion, Hugo. I will continue to cherish and value your advice, even if you are no longer my official Grand Vizier."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your faith only goes skin deep. As..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your faith only goes skin deep. As for me, it lives within my very soul."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""No, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Now and always.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now and always."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I do understand. Perfectly well.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do understand. Perfectly well."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I supported your new constitution..."
entries.dialogueText: "I supported your new constitution in our talks before, and I do now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have not seen the future. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have not seen the future. You don't know the prophecies. Grand Wiseman Ignacius does."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. I appreci..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I appreciate that."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I beg to differ, Your Majesty. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg to differ, Your Majesty. But your mind is clearly made up."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course I do not question the Gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I do not question the Grand Wiseman's vision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I let you live. Count yourself luc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I let you live. Count yourself lucky."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I do. Forgive me.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do. Forgive me."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""You have most decidedly strayed fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have most decidedly strayed from the path followed by Queen Lyza and King Valero."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""But I wish you the best of luck in..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I wish you the best of luck in this new direction."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And I'll miss all your little jape..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I'll miss all your little japes."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""For my part, I am glad to have pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "For my part, I am glad to have played a small role in the return of Zille. Truly a historic feat."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But I hope the change in governmen..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I hope the change in government brings a fresh start and new possibilities for peace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May God be with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "May God be with you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please feel free to visit the Pala..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please feel free to visit the Palace anytime."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My now ex-councilors left, closing..."
entries.dialogueText: My now ex-councilors left, closing the door behind them.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I did not support your reforms whe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not support your reforms when you introduced them, and I do not now. But ultimately, it was not my choice to make."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I just hope you will continue to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just hope you will continue to seek my advice when you need it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You advised me to marry your son t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You advised me to marry your son to my daughter. You don't exactly have a stellar track record."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo struggled to keep a smile on h..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo struggled to keep a smile on his face.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will. Nobody knows our house and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will. Nobody knows our house and Valenqiris better than you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't need it. But thanks for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't need it. But thanks for the offer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You still have a valuable role to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You still have a valuable role to play, Your Grace. We all do."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I was trying to set the monarchy b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was trying to set the monarchy back on track after the mistakes my brother made. I didn't know that you were planning to derail it altogether."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I thank you for your reassurance.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thank you for your reassurance."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That is indisputable.""
entries.dialogueText: "That is indisputable."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo struggled to keep a smile on h..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo struggled to keep a smile on his face.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You are welcome.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are welcome."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and the others lined up in front..."
entries.dialogueText: He and the others lined up in front of me. I shook each of their hands in turn.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish you all a happy retirement.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you all a happy retirement."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena, Laurento, Titus and I gather..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena, Laurento, Titus and I gathered once more in my council chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena, Laurento, Taddeus and I gath..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena, Laurento, Taddeus and I gathered once more in my council chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo, Elena, Laurento, Lucita and I..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo, Elena, Laurento, Lucita and I gathered once more in my council chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo, Elena, Laurento, Titus and I..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo, Elena, Laurento, Titus and I gathered once more in my council chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo, Elena, Laurento, Taddeus and..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo, Elena, Laurento, Taddeus and I gathered once more in my council chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around the room at my advi..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around the room at my advisors. All of them had pledged their lives in service to the Crown. To my family.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But there was no place for them in..."
entries.dialogueText: But there was no place for them in the new Rizia.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're all getting on in years, an..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're all getting on in years, anyway. The governance of this country shouldn't be trusted to a group of senior citizens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need to grovel. Neither of you..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to grovel. Neither of you work for me anymore."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What will you do with all your fre..."
entries.dialogueText: "What will you do with all your free time now?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I truly thank you both for your se..."
entries.dialogueText: "I truly thank you both for your service. Without your dedication, Rizia would never have been reborn."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now that you no longer serve me, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that you no longer serve me, I have to know. Did the two of you ever...?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They looked around the room, then a..."
entries.dialogueText: They looked around the room, then at each other. Both laughed.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""That's one secret that will die wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's one secret that will die with our council positions, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus pushed his chair back, got to..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus pushed his chair back, got to his feet and saluted.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We shall see. Simply catching up w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shall see. Simply catching up with all of my grandchildren will take the better part of the next year."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I meant every word.""
entries.dialogueText: "I meant every word."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Good luck, Your Majesty. I mean th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck, Your Majesty. I mean that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal Ignacius rushed into the room j..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal Ignacius rushed into the room just as the clock struck four, bowing profusely in apology.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Thank you for entrusting me with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for entrusting me with this role, even if it was only for a short time."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As captain of the Wruhec's Guardia..."
entries.dialogueText: "As captain of the Wruhec's Guardians, I will be no less committed to this kingdom's security."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As captain of the Golden Guard, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "As captain of the Golden Guard, I shall remain equally committed to Rizia's security."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus gruffly saluted from his wh..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus gruffly saluted from his wheelchair.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you for entrusting me with m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for entrusting me with my former role, albeit under unfortunate circumstances."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My house and I will continue to su..."
entries.dialogueText: "My house and I will continue to support you and our kingdom, no matter which form it takes."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Best of luck to you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Best of luck to you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita pushed back her chair and go..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita pushed back her chair and got to her feet.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We have not seen the last of each..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have not seen the last of each other, Your Majesty. I won't leave Porte Drazon until I've seen the Pales War through."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But I'm grateful to have served yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I'm grateful to have served you. Once we've emerged victorious, I hope there's a position for me in the new government."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She put a hand on her stomach."
entries.dialogueText: She put a hand on her stomach.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Besides that of Queen Consort, I m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Besides that of Queen Consort, I mean."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm grateful for this opportunity,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm grateful for this opportunity, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She spoke in a cool tone."
entries.dialogueText: She spoke in a cool tone.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I know we haven't always seen eye..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know we haven't always seen eye to eye during these meetings, but I hope there's a position for me in the new government."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Now that I'm fired... I wish you'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that I'm fired... I wish you'd held off on your reforms until the war was over."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My father and I could've helped yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father and I could've helped you crush Pales. With this new ceasefire resolution, Rizia has snatched defeat from the jaws of victory."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Nonetheless, I hope I'm worthy of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonetheless, I hope I'm worthy of a position in the new government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was a pleasure, Lucita. I mean..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a pleasure, Lucita. I mean that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good luck with your new endeavors,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck with your new endeavors, Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whether or not you remain in gover..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether or not you remain in government, your valor in the conflict will be rewarded."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is a place in Rizia for all..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a place in Rizia for all who are faithful. You cannot serve me until you serve Him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll see what I can do.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see what I can do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whether or not you remain in gover..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether or not you remain in government, your service will be rewarded."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have my gratitude, General.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have my gratitude, General."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I trust you to keep Cardesse-Monta..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you to keep Cardesse-Montaklar in line."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I too wish the circumstances were..."
entries.dialogueText: "I too wish the circumstances were different."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita. If it is said, so it shal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita. If it is said, so it shall be."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am counting on it, Captain.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am counting on it, Captain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm glad I could keep you on. Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad I could keep you on. Rizia needs continuity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I expect there to be significantly..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect there to be significantly fewer attempts on my life from now on. But I appreciate your enthusiasm."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I don't doubt it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't doubt it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others looked away uncomfortabl..."
entries.dialogueText: The others looked away uncomfortably.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The same to you.""
entries.dialogueText: "The same to you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Maybe someday, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe someday, then."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal clasped his hands and looked at..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal clasped his hands and looked at me pleadingly.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""A kingdom without religion is no k..."
entries.dialogueText: "A kingdom without religion is no kingdom at all, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The new government must not abando..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new government must not abandon God, Your Majesty. I hope you will make sure of that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's the 20th century, Sal. Get wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the 20th century, Sal. Get with the times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will always rely on God to guide..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will always rely on God to guide me. In that way, He will be guiding this kingdom too."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The faithful will always have a pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "The faithful will always have a place in Rizia, Grand Wiseman. Do not worry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm surprised Sotelato would deign..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised Sotelato would deign to meet with royals."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I wasn't invited?""
entries.dialogueText: "And I wasn't invited?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Careful. These reforms are meant t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Careful. These reforms are meant to empower normal citizens, not further your own political career."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""She'll see you Thursday for your w..."
entries.dialogueText: "She'll see you Thursday for your weekly briefing."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He'll see you Thursday for your we..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know, Father. I'm not trying to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Father. I'm not trying to influence the new government."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He's grateful to us for our role i..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's grateful to us for our role in the reforms. Even if he doesn't publicly express it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""For now. We'll see what happens af..."
entries.dialogueText: "For now. We'll see what happens after the elections."

entries.dialogueText: The room was silent for a long moment. I glanced towards the Grand Vizier chair where Sal was sitting.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Well, then. As Grand Vizier of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, then. As Grand Vizier of the newly established holy kingdom of Rizia, I declare this meeting adjourned."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena and the others lined up in fr..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena and the others lined up in front of me. I shook each of their hands in turn.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""God bless you all.""
entries.dialogueText: "God bless you all."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There's little we could do if we t..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's little we could do if we tried, Your Majesty. Democracy has won."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your tardiness is excused. This is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your tardiness is excused. This is the last of these meetings, after all."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know. And I'll miss them.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know. And I'll miss them."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Since I had been forced to turn against the entire nobility, including my closest of kin.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The nobles who had been temporarily..."
entries.dialogueText: The nobles who had been temporarily detained were now free. But I knew they'd never forget what I'd done.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: For now, it was time for one last meeting with my councilors.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few weeks had passed since the ev..."
entries.dialogueText: A few weeks had passed since the events of my mother's birthday.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Since I'd been forced to turn again..."
entries.dialogueText: Since I'd been forced to turn against my own family.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Since my wife -- and our unborn chi..."
entries.dialogueText: Since my wife -- and our unborn child -- had died before my very eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Since my wife had been sent to pris..."
entries.dialogueText: Since my wife had been sent to prison -- and lost our unborn child.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Since I had finally proven my domin..."
entries.dialogueText: Since I had finally proven my dominion over the mighty House of Azaro.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Since the traitors of House Sazon h..."
entries.dialogueText: Since the traitors of House Sazon had received their just desserts.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the meantime, Sal had been busy..."
entries.dialogueText: In the meantime, Sal had been busy with preparations setting up our new government.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the shadow of the growing domina..."
entries.dialogueText: In the shadow of the growing dominance of the Wruhecist faithful, the revolutionary movement had withered. Unrest no longer plagued the nation. My control over Rizia was unopposed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few months had passed since my de..."
entries.dialogueText: A few months had passed since my decision to transform Rizia into a theocracy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Since my mother's birthday, Sal and..."
entries.dialogueText: Since my mother's birthday, Sal and I had been working hard on preparations for the new government.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had big plans ahead of me. But fi..."
entries.dialogueText: I had big plans ahead of me. But first, I had to meet with my councilors for the last time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But I had no time to revel in my co..."
entries.dialogueText: But I had no time to revel in my conquest. Revolutionary unrest still plagued the kingdom, and an emergency council meeting had been called to discuss our next steps.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had tried to notify Vina, but the..."
entries.dialogueText: I had tried to notify Vina, but there was no sign of her. In fact, I hadn't heard from my daughter at all in the past weeks.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew she didn't approve of what I..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew she didn't approve of what I'd done. I could only hope she'd understand in time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew she didn't approve of the ch..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew she didn't approve of the change in government. I could only hope she'd understand in time.
